theme_central: Twelve cosmic signs announce the Hour — then an oath by the stars and the night to authenticate the word of a noble, trustworthy messenger.
sources_note: List of the twelve signs widely taught and undisputed; 3-movement structure well established.

branches.title: Twelve signs of the Hour
branches.resume: Sun darkened, stars falling, mountains set in motion, seas made to boil over, records laid open.

children.t: Sun darkened, stars falling, seas boiling over, the buried infant girl questioned
Records laid open, sky stripped away, Hell set ablaze, Paradise brought near; every soul will know what it has brought

branches.title: Oath by the stars
branches.resume: Oath by the stars that recede, the night, the dawn — authenticating a noble, trustworthy messenger.

children.t: Oath by the stars and the dawn; a noble, trustworthy messenger

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: This is not the word of a devil; this is a reminder for whoever wishes to walk the straight path.

children.t: Refutation of demonic inspiration, a reminder for whoever wishes to walk straight
